title: BlueBlocks: Deployment Scripts & Configuration
description:
Create deployment automation scripts and configuration files.

## Shell Scripts
- deploy-devnet.sh - Start/stop/status for local development network
- deploy-testnet.sh - Multi-node testnet management with health checks
- Makefile - Convenience commands for all operations

## Configuration Files
- Genesis files (devnet/testnet) with initial accounts, validators
- Environment templates (.env.example)
- Docker volume and network configuration

## Commands Available
make devnet-start/stop/restart/status/logs/destroy
make testnet-start/stop/restart/status/health/logs/destroy
make build/build-devnet/build-testnet
make test-api/test-faucet
make monitoring-start/stop
make clean/clean-all
